config.optigen.title: OptiGen
config.optigen.appliesOnWorldLoad: Takes effect the next time a world is loaded.
config.optigen.group.threads.description: Vanilla decorates each dimension's chunks one at a time on a single thread. OptiGen can spread that work, plus terrain, light-source scans and mob spawning, over every core.
config.optigen.parallelGeneration.descri: Generate chunks on all worker threads at once. Chunks that could touch each other are never worked on at the same time, so the result matches single-threaded generation. Automatically off when C2ME is installed.
config.optigen.workerThreads.description: How many threads OptiGen generates with. Auto uses every core. Lower it to leave CPU for other programs while you play.
config.optigen.lowerWorkerPriority.descr: Run workers one priority step below normal, so the game keeps a smooth tick rate while chunks generate at full speed in the background.
config.optigen.group.decoration.descript: Skip decoration a beatable world doesn't need. These only affect chunks generated from now on.
config.optigen.trimOres.description: Skip copper, redstone, lapis and emerald ore. Coal, iron, gold and diamonds always generate.
config.optigen.skipUndergroundDecoration: Skip dungeons, fossils, geodes, fluid springs, glow lichen and granite/diorite/andesite/tuff/dirt/gravel blobs. There are no caves to show them off anyway.
config.optigen.category.dh.tooltip: How OptiGen works with Distant Horizons.
config.optigen.dhLodGenerator.descriptio: Build LODs directly from OptiGen's terrain at every detail level, without generating chunks. Turning this off makes DH use its own generator, which can't read OptiGen terrain and is much slower.
config.optigen.dhUseAllCores.description: Run Distant Horizons' world generation on every core at 100% run time. This is applied through DH's API; your DH config file is not changed.
config.optigen.lodTreeCanopy.description: Paint a simple tree canopy onto forests in LODs, so distant forests don't look bald. Applies to LODs generated from now on.
config.optigen.dhMaxRenderDistance.descr: Raises the highest render distance you can pick in Distant Horizons' own settings (normally 4096 chunks). Set the actual distance in DH as usual. On servers, DH's request limits are raised to match, unless an admin set them lower on purpose.
config.optigen.dhMaxRenderDistance.warni: Very large distances use a lot of memory, VRAM and disk space, and take a while to fill in.
